Container.Name: SoloFlow
Container.Overview: Self-hosted bookkeeping for Australian sole traders. Import business bank and credit card statements (PDF or CSV), check they add up, and keep everything on your own server.[br][br]Needs a PostgreSQL 14+ database: install a PostgreSQL 16 container first, create a "soloflow" user and database, then fill in Database URL below. Read docs/UNRAID.md in the repository for the steps.
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL 14 or newer database (for example the postgresql16 container from Community Applications).

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port for the SoloFlow web page.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Where automatic and manual backups are written. Include this folder in your own backups too.

Config.Name: Secret
Config.Description: A long random string (32+ characters) that encrypts account numbers and two-step secrets. Keep a copy somewhere safe and never change it: without it they cannot be read, even from a backup.

Config.Name: Address
Config.Description: Optional. The address people use to reach SoloFlow, for links in alerts and invites, for example http://tower.local:3000

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for backup times and dates.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Set to true only when SoloFlow is reached over HTTPS (for example behind a reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Update check address
Config.Description: Optional. A JSON address that answers {"version": "x.y.z"}, for the Check for updates button.
